name: ocg-inventory-data-pipeline
description: Weekly job: pull BabelCDB + yukisaba/EDOPro_japanese + Yugipedia set/rarity data and build the merged read-only dataset the app syncs.

scripts.all: npm run fetch:babelcdb && npm run fetch:ja-texts && npm run fetch:yugipedia && npm run fetch:yugipedia-cards && npm run fetch:card-hashes && npm run fetch:card-prices && npm run build && npm run changelog
